## 分诊 · `domain:devx` / `priority:p3` / `pm:queue`

**Anchor read, not guessed.** The deliverable is `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` — content-docs ⇒ `domain:devx`, ⛔ not `domain:spec`, even though the schema that proves the gap lives in `packages/spec`. Nothing in `packages/spec` changes.

Re-measured on `origin/main` `f1d7872` (2026-09-04T23:47:57Z), with the control the filer's own claim needs:

| read | result |
|---|---|
| `bulkActions` in `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` | **0** |
| `dataset` (case-insensitive) in the same page | **0** — the word genuinely does not occur |
| positive control — `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` | fires: `:206` documents `objects.<object>._views.<view_name>.bulkActions.<def_name>.*`, `:217` maps three author spellings onto `bulkActions`, `:224` explains what is addressed under it |

⇒ both zeros are real absences, not a broken pattern. The groups are declared, live, and documented **in the schema**, and absent from the page whose job is to inventory them.

### Grade — p3

The card grades itself correctly and this seat is adopting that rather than inflating it: *"a different defect (missing documentation, not a false sentence)."* Nothing on the page is wrong, no gate is red, no author is steered into a broken path — the failure is that an author scanning the inventory concludes two live surfaces are not translatable and does not try. Real, but recoverable by anyone who runs `os i18n extract` or reads `os lint` coverage output, both of which already report these groups.

⚠️ What would move it to p2 is evidence that someone actually hand-rolled around it. If that turns up, say so on this card rather than filing a new one.

### Boundary test — Bug/tidy, no manual floor

Adding inventory rows for surfaces that already ship restores documented = shipped. Nothing becomes authorable that was not already.

### One thing that makes this bigger than "two table rows"

The card is right that the `datasets` group has nowhere to land: **the page has no dataset section at all.** So the honest shape is two table rows *plus* enough prose for `datasets.NAME.label` / `description` / `dimensions.DIM.label` / `measures.MEASURE.label` to mean something to a reader who has never seen a dataset. ⛔ Do not land the table rows alone and call it closed — an inventory row pointing at a concept the page never introduces is the next card, not the fix.

`packages/spec/liveness/translation.json`'s header is the citation to lean on while writing it (it records `datasets` as *"seeded LIVE and DRILLED by #14253 with its reader in the same change"*), and `translation.zod.ts:206`/`:217`/`:224` is the equivalent for `bulkActions`.

### Scope fence — endorsed

⛔ The `_validations` row is **not** in scope; it lands with #14402. Three surfaces came out of #14381 / #14253 and they are deliberately split across two cards by *kind of defect* (a false sentence vs. a missing entry), not by convenience. That split is correct and should survive — do not "helpfully" fold the third row in here, and do not wait on #14402 to start: the two edits touch different rows of the same table and a merge conflict there is trivial next to the coordination cost of blocking.

⛔ Not a claim, not a dispatch — routing only.

**Ruling (binding):** docs-only, `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`. Add the two missing groups to the "What you can translate" table with the key shapes the schema declares (`objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW.bulkActions.NAME.{label,confirmText,confirmLabel,params}`; `datasets.NAME.{label,description}`, `datasets.NAME.dimensions.DIM.label`, `datasets.NAME.measures.MEASURE.label`) — read the shapes from `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` on the branch base and quote the lines, do not copy the card. Add the smallest prose the `datasets` group needs (the page has no dataset section: one short paragraph or a sub-heading in the page's existing style, no new page). Every key shape you write must be one `os i18n extract` produces and `os lint` coverage reports — verify against the extractor/reader (`translateView` / `translateDataset`) and quote where each key is read. Do not touch `packages/**`, the `_validations` row (landed with #14402 — confirm it is present on your base), or `content/docs/releases/**`.

Hot file `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` is free in this lane now. Verification: the docs gates the derivation names (`check:doc-authoring`, `check:docs-transcript-drift` if derived — exit 3 here if it needs `packages/lint/dist`, NOT MEASURED by name), `check:i18n*` families if derived, `dispatch-gates --changed --commands` family, `check:nul-bytes`, governed test; and a positive/negative grep control on the page before/after (`bulkActions` 0 → n, `dataset` 0 → n).
